video_title: Is Jalen Brunson's 2026 Championship Year BETTER than Derrick Rose's 2011 MVP season 👀

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on why Derrick Rose's MVP season is undervalued
quotes.excerpt: he was the youngest MVP we've ever had.
quotes.quote: A lot of you all do not hold Derrick Rose in the regard he should be held in. And he was the youngest MVP we've ever had. So, I said that to say, it makes that point not valid because we're watching you all not hold Derrick Rose in the regard that he should be held in.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green compares winning a championship to winning an MVP
quotes.excerpt: a championship for a first option to deliver a championship and a championship for an MVP
quotes.quote: A championship for a first option to deliver a championship and a championship for an MVP. How I know the argument doesn't work is because when you weigh the two. Jalen Brunson just won a championship as a first option. And what I'm certain of is all of you basketball people hold Jalen Brunson at this point right now in a higher regard than you hold Derrick Rose.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson and Draymond Green debate Brunson versus Rose
quotes.excerpt: most people are going to put Jalen Brunson over Derrick Rose today.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: We've had the ring versus MVP conversation, but I think it is very interesting because most people are going to put Jalen Brunson over Derrick Rose today. And that might not just be recency bias, but when people say MVPs are more, I don't think so.

text_blocks.speaker: Draymond Green
text_blocks.text: It's not about MVPs are more. I think it's just the whole totality, the whole body of work. Jalen Brunson left Dallas from a role to going to be number one option and his team got better every year. They got further and further. They got chances, then they won as him the number one option.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on why Jalen Brunson's career trajectory is impressive
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson is in front of him because Jalen Brunson has done more.
quotes.quote: With Derrick Rose's career ending the way it did and he was able to accomplish the things that we all knew he was going to be able to do, yes, I have to put Jalen Brunson in front of him because Jalen Brunson has done more. He did. That's what it is. So it ain't based on just MVP. If Derrick Rose got a chance to play more, I don't know. I don't know what the answer would be. Right now, it's Jalen Brunson because Jalen Brunson won and he's done more.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on Jalen Brunson's historic MVP win
quotes.excerpt: the youngest player to win an MVP in NBA history.
quotes.quote: Are you saying you're holding what Jalen Brunson did for the Knicks, being the youngest player to win an MVP in NBA history. Who did he win the MVP trophy over?

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on the impact of injuries on Derrick Rose's career
quotes.excerpt: he had injuries. We can talk about Grant Hill, we can talk about Tracy McGrady.
quotes.quote: He had injuries. We can talk about Grant Hill, we can talk about Tracy McGrady. We can talk about a lot of guys who we would be talking about in a different light if these guys didn't have injuries. That's just what it is. I hate it for Derrick Rose. I love the man to death. You know how I rock with Derrick Rose. I fuck with him on a high level.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on Derrick Rose's future Hall of Fame status
quotes.excerpt: he's the youngest MVP ever in history. He's going to be a Hall of Famer.
quotes.quote: He's the youngest MVP ever in history. He's going to be a Hall of Famer. There's no way in hell. I don't care. He's going to be a Hall of Famer because he's done something nobody's ever done. Derrick Rose is still going to be a Hall of Famer.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton picks Jalen Brunson over Derrick Rose
quotes.excerpt: I think right now, D Rose. Lay down probably Brunson.
quotes.quote: I think right now, D Rose. Lay down probably Brunson. Because Jalen Brunson is going to obviously continue to get better. He's going to continue to be able to lead his team. And as Ray said, the injuries aspect is what takes away from Derrick Rose's effect.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on the dominance of Derrick Rose in his prime
quotes.excerpt: at Derrick Rose's prime, nobody was seeing the dude.
quotes.quote: At Derrick Rose's prime, nobody was seeing the dude. Every game you had to run double teams and triple teams and he was still zooming around the motherfuckers and dunking. There was a D Rose flu.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on the impact of Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: I don't think anybody is ducking Jalen Brunson. People were ducking Derrick Rose.
quotes.quote: I don't think anybody is ducking Jalen Brunson. People were ducking Derrick Rose. Point guards didn't want to see him. They were taking that night off.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on the difficulty of comparing careers
quotes.excerpt: if we talk about careers, Jalen Brunson has done more as far as winning than Derrick Rose.
quotes.quote: If we talk about careers, Jalen Brunson has done more as far as winning than Derrick Rose. Now, as an individual, as an individual, he's the youngest MVP ever, so what we talking about? It's levels to that.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on Jalen Brunson's historic championship win
quotes.excerpt: he won a championship with the Knicks that nobody ever thought was going to happen.
quotes.quote: He won a championship with the Knicks that nobody ever thought was going to happen. So he won a championship there. That's why it's up there. But as far as we're talking about individuals right now, we're talking about individuals. We're not talking about teams. We're talking about individuals.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on Derrick Rose being the youngest MVP
quotes.excerpt: this man as an individual as the youngest player ever to win an MVP.
quotes.quote: This man as an individual as the youngest player ever to win an MVP. How old was he? I feel like the motherfucker was like, what, 23? And he won it over LeBron, Kobe, KD. If there's one thing Draymond said correct, we're not giving him enough flowers. We're not giving him enough flowers for that.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on Jalen Brunson versus Derrick Rose
quotes.excerpt: they saying Jalen Brunson the greatest Nick of all time.
quotes.quote: They saying Jalen Brunson the greatest Nick of all time. Derrick Rose ain't the greatest Bull of all time, though. We know who that is. Yeah, but that's hard. That's hard. I'm just saying you got to add all this stuff in there now. You got to add all that in there because that's what everybody was saying because y'all killed me when I said it's Patrick Ewing and you know other people that was all time the best Nick of all time. Y'all said it's Jalen Brunson.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on Michael Jordan in New York
quotes.excerpt: if Michael Jordan was in New York, then we'd have the conversation right now.
quotes.quote: If Michael Jordan was in New York, then we'd have the conversation right now. You said it was Jalen Brunson.
